# @fyit/crouton-assets

> Asset management - media library with NuxtHub blob storage

AI hint: use when app has media uploads or file management

## Components

- `CroutonAssetsAssetTile`: Selection tile for Picker modal with selected state and checkmark
- `CroutonAssetsCard`: Media card for CroutonCollection grid (image/icon, edit/delete)
- `CroutonAssetsForm`: Asset create/upload form (the assets collection form)
- `CroutonAssetsFormUpdate`: Asset update/metadata edit form
- `CroutonAssetsLibrary`: Full media library browser using CroutonCollection
- `CroutonAssetsPicker`: Asset picker with gallery modal for selecting from media library
- `CroutonAssetsUploader`: Upload component with optional crop step and metadata form

Props, events and slots: [components.md](components.md)

## Composables

- `useAssetUpload`
